### Key Risks

- **Extreme drowsiness and dizziness:** Their sedative effects amplify each other, increasing the chance of falls, accidents, and trouble waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX46gsTWKVm5dA7r7_5s6yvZw9WVWOflwXRL0WuVUoXoMA5xcUIAVxchpG98HPYpQ1AFasMQjEKAy83x2HcjeiZLfJ8_4l-3H_VAoIIjZ2v0YwtBnERMHmLZAKkWM2aI38na4vA6obpZGN)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXw1rSZ-jOq-GtwFIl5-9ooFQvnEQGV_AEnqpzndlvCt_ot90THsmsiPgkQdUXzuoepaZ0RbBNe8Lsi9X5soj5-suhkNxieExnO3bWV1XK0fQcr84AtapX4wsFIXI0Pj3ilD8TSYdYB5WF4m64QtZ67f6C)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1zGpkJi_yFJWln8qC5JKXO76k5ZBg8nxn03jaDKdQHbCJcn_EPlqgBBkCnB4o3jEUQn850F5HZU8UTEws3YPmiKXvHIT1-96eu3SfLa7BYGD9vnMytJMmJa8IZze5xSL3sKwkZi0Fvv2DHqCybq-hM8SVbtpUagknHoCJSC5y1g9FysSWANUwL9PXA)
- **Impaired driving and coordination:** Reaction time, judgment, and motor skills drop sharply—even if you feel alert.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXrhtKVIiTNnYFXvSjNh6ugIlorYSiorQ5pG6OcDi8dEBxMv-F9j7KgsjEpiKoY61AYjJqc7PErnHkU2vpnbmmlSsfptDtu2bdBuWfCtdKQaqGtyetgFBoY7GA5gQ8PHjMPklCN46_Kg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXw1rSZ-jOq-GtwFIl5-9ooFQvnEQGV_AEnqpzndlvCt_ot90THsmsiPgkQdUXzuoepaZ0RbBNe8Lsi9X5soj5-suhkNxieExnO3bWV1XK0fQcr84AtapX4wsFIXI0Pj3ilD8TSYdYB5WF4m64QtZ67f6C)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXalaex28KhYRiBB1eSmdpkZoOQKoBYo8T3_7thESADb_DpEuxcjLd06fGl4RhIIcK5MSkzjc5HBqn6K7VaSmFyKXvJfBAM-lsqdDEpqRE1FWSNIo40lr1TjyDhiaF2POCSZMr7rjZSmYcpS1CwMufwMlp4M8)

- **Avoid mixing them:** Skip alcohol while taking Benadryl, and do not take Benadryl to sleep after drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXalaex28KhYRiBB1eSmdpkZoOQKoBYo8T3_7thESADb_DpEuxcjLd06fGl4RhIIcK5MSkzjc5HBqn6K7VaSmFyKXvJfBAM-lsqdDEpqRE1FWSNIo40lr1TjyDhiaF2POCSZMr7rjZSmYcpS1CwMufwMlp4M8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXw1rSZ-jOq-GtwFIl5-9ooFQvnEQGV_AEnqpzndlvCt_ot90THsmsiPgkQdUXzuoepaZ0RbBNe8Lsi9X5soj5-suhkNxieExnO3bWV1XK0fQcr84AtapX4wsFIXI0Pj3ilD8TSYdYB5WF4m64QtZ67f6C)

- **Watch for hidden ingredients:** Check labels on "PM" products, cold/flu syrups, and laxatives, as they may contain diphenhydramine or hidden alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXw1rSZ-jOq-GtwFIl5-9ooFQvnEQGV_AEnqpzndlvCt_ot90THsmsiPgkQdUXzuoepaZ0RbBNe8Lsi9X5soj5-suhkNxieExnO3bWV1XK0fQcr84AtapX4wsFIXI0Pj3ilD8TSYdYB5WF4m64QtZ67f6C)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXalaex28KhYRiBB1eSmdpkZoOQKoBYo8T3_7thESADb_DpEuxcjLd06fGl4RhIIcK5MSkzjc5HBqn6K7VaSmFyKXvJfBAM-lsqdDEpqRE1FWSNIo40lr1TjyDhiaF2POCSZMr7rjZSmYcpS1CwMufwMlp4M8)
